description: This Kotlin source file defines the CompassSensorManager class, which manages device sensors related to compass and orientation detection. It handles sensor registration, sensor event processing, and azimuth smoothing to provide stable directional readings, typically used for compass-like functionalities in an Android app.

classes.name: CompassSensorManager
classes.description: A class that manages device sensors to compute the orientation azimuth, providing smooth and updated directional readings based on sensor data.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Registers sensor listeners, prioritizing rotation vector sensor for orientation updates, falling back to accelerometer and magnetometer if necessary.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Unregisters sensor listeners and resets internal state related to sensor readings and azimuth.

methods.name: onSensorChanged
methods.description: Handles sensor events, processing rotation vector, accelerometer, and magnetometer data to compute azimuth and pass it to the listener.

methods.name: computeFallback
methods.description: Computes orientation from accelerometer and magnetometer data if rotation vector is unavailable or to verify readings, then updates azimuth.

methods.name: smooth
methods.description: Applies exponential smoothing to the azimuth angle to reduce jitter while maintaining responsiveness.

methods.name: onAccuracyChanged
methods.description: Callback for sensor accuracy change events, left unimplemented as handling is done during sensor events.
